founder.imageAlt: Karen Schenck, founder of Vision Human Consulting, at her desk in front of the VHC monogram
founder.text: After more than twenty years in sales strategy, marketing, management and customer experience, Karen Schenck founded Vision Human Consulting on one conviction: a company's performance rests on the coherence between its strategy, its decisions and its practices. And the human factor is its most underestimated lever.

items.question: What is the difference between your consulting and your training?
items.answer: Consulting addresses a situation specific to your company: we analyse your organisation, identify friction points and support the changes. Training gives your teams directly applicable methods and tools on a specific topic, such as sales performance in new-build real estate or growing an agency.

items.question: What is the ODC method?
items.answer: ODC stands for Observe, Decode, Consolidate. It structures every engagement: observe the situation as it is actually lived, decode the causes and interactions between findings, then consolidate concrete, prioritised directions with tracking indicators.

items.question: How long does an engagement last?
items.answer: It depends on the level of support. The strategic audit is sized to the scope analysed. Targeted transformation is a two-week engagement. Sustainable executive alignment is tailored with the leadership team. The duration is always agreed before starting.

items.question: Do we have to start with an audit?
items.answer: Targeted transformation builds on the findings of an audit, which is the safest starting point to act on the right levers. During the first conversation, we decide together which level of support best fits your situation.

items.question: Can your training be adapted to our company?
items.answer: Yes. The new-build real estate and real estate agency courses run over one 7-hour day, on-site or remote, in-company (and inter-company for agencies). The higher-education course is built around the institution's needs.

items.question: How does the first conversation work?
items.answer: Book a slot online or contact us by email or phone. This no-commitment first conversation lets us understand your context and challenges, then suggest the most relevant format.

methodPage.title: A concrete, cross-functional approach
methodPage.intro: A company's performance rests in particular on the coherence between its strategy, its decisions and its practices. When that coherence weakens, it can quickly affect how an organisation works and the results it achieves.
paragraphs: The ODC method analyses together the different dimensions that influence a company's activity, in order to identify gaps, understand how they interact and determine the most relevant levers for action.
ODC connects the findings of the analysis to understand their causes and consequences. This makes it possible to prioritise needs and build concrete responses suited to the issues identified.

founder.title: The founder
paragraphs: Karen Schenck has spent more than twenty years in sales strategy, marketing, management and customer experience. Field experience that taught her to recognise what dashboards don't show: the gaps between what is decided and what is actually lived inside the organisation.

She founded Vision Human Consulting to put this cross-functional reading at the service of businesses, with a method, ODC, and a standard: actionable recommendations, clear objectives and tracking indicators.
